requirement.original_prompt: 构建可伸缩、弹性、插件化且高内聚低耦合的平台架构，支持企业申请审批、共享资产、权限、审计、埋点以及自动化和Agent操作，并使用ai-batch-runner推进实现。
requirement.interpreted_goal: 先冻结跨仓库的通用Workflow、权限、资产、审计、Telemetry、Agent和Plugin契约，再以sverpweb采购申请审批作为受控第一垂直切片，保持当前单租户约束并为后续独立扩展和弹性部署提供边界。
requirement.success_outcome: 申请、审批、执行、通知、审计、撤销和补偿能够通过统一operation/workflow链路追踪；后端权限和租户隔离有效；Agent不能越权；首切片可通过单仓库门禁和组合契约测试。

p0: 冻结ExecutionContext、租户和部门引用契约
sverpweb采购审批首切片保持approved与executed分离
关键业务变更使用durable outbox并接入snaplink-audit-governance
Snaplink、组织和资源服务执行后端权限和撤销
Agent使用限租户、限资源、限动作、短时Capability Grant
当前sverpweb继续单租户，不宣称已完成共享多租户
p1: 部门和财务顺序审批、超时、拒绝、取消和补偿
OTel Trace、流程指标和操作时间线关联
组合E2E覆盖审计、撤销、恢复和Agent行为
p2: 会签、或签和复杂审批路由
Agent执行低风险已批准动作
外部typed RPC插件和独立Workflow Worker
p3: 插件市场和第三方UI扩展生态
跨地域流程和资源调度

scenario.entry: 用户在sverpweb创建采购草稿并提交，服务端从Snaplink解析身份/租户，从组织服务解析稳定department_id，生成ProcessInstance和WorkItem。
preconditions: Snaplink身份、会话、租户上下文和提交权限有效
department_id与tenant_id可由服务端解析，不能只依赖部门名称
采购请求schema、审批策略版本和幂等键有效
业务本地数据库能够在同一事务中写入状态和audit outbox
附件asset_id（如有）属于当前租户并由aero-vault确认
happy_path: 申请人提交采购申请，业务状态和流程状态进入待审批
创建部门审批WorkItem并记录审批资格快照
金额/风险策略触发财务审批时创建第二个WorkItem
审批决定全部通过后，流程进入execution_pending/approved
关键事件经Outbox投递至audit-governance，通知经aero-im异步发送
failure_paths: 身份、租户、组织或资源授权失败时fail_closed，不创建或不推进关键流程
审批拒绝或超时后关闭待办并进入rejected/expired
关键字段改变导致旧审批失效并重新路由
业务命令失败时按界限重试，超限转人工或补偿
审计远程投递失败时保留本地durable outbox并重试，不静默丢失
通知失败只影响delivery status，不改变审批和执行真值
Agent Grant撤销后未来工具调用必须失败
follow_up: 通过audit-governance operation timeline核对申请、审批和执行
对已执行副作用按领域补偿契约恢复，不能篡改原始审计事件
撤销用户、部门、Capability或流程后重新验证未来访问
通过suite契约和组合E2E后再扩展会签、外部插件和多租户

existing: aero-vault的文件、对象、ACL、分享、版本和恢复基础
snaplink-audit-governance的事件接入、不可变账本、操作时间线、WORM、恢复审批和回放
sverpweb的采购申请、审批状态和审计Outbox基础
snaplink-console与iris-ui的管理视图和路由投影基础
sso-server已有的Profile、静态模块、外部typed plugin和lock参考
extend: sverpweb的独立Workflow状态和Outbox关键事件语义
Snaplink的workflow/approval权限映射和Agent委托上下文
各服务的OTel operation/workflow/run关联和流程指标
sverpweb与Vault之间的asset reference而非重复ACL
create: Agent task Capability Grant、撤销和fencing contract
跨仓库failure matrix、compatibility matrix和组合E2E契约
excluded: 第一阶段创建独立workflow仓库
任意Go .so、任意脚本或任意远程代码插件
Agent自动批准付款、删除、ACL修改或跨租户共享
一次性迁移所有历史FileShareStore关系
用审计回放直接修改业务状态

synchronous_calls: sverpweb-stable -> snaplink: validate tenant, identity and workflow approval capability
sverpweb-stable -> aero-id: resolve department_id and approval membership through bounded adapter
sverpweb-stable -> aero-vault: validate referenced asset_id only when an attachment is part of the command
workflows: purchase-approval@v1: submit -> department approval -> optional finance approval -> execution -> completion
purchase-compensation@v1: execution failure or post-execution correction -> compensation decision -> domain compensation
agent-assist@v1: agent suggestion -> optional human decision -> bounded execution

apis: Preserve existing sverpweb purchase API shape and add server-derived operation_id, workflow_instance_id and idempotency semantics
Add workflow status and work item read model for user and operator progress
Add bounded organization department/membership adapter contract
Add capability grant validation and revocation context to Agent task execution
Reuse audit-governance events ingest and receipt APIs
migrations: sverpweb audit outbox actor and workflow provenance fields
transitional department_id fields with unresolved mapping state
configurations: workflow definition and policy version registry
audit critical-event durable mode and ledger acknowledgment policy
Agent grant limits, expiration, resource scope and kill switch
Plugin manifest lock, digest, signature and compatibility window
per-tenant workflow, Agent, queue and audit budgets
OTel exporter and bounded telemetry labels
ui: sverpweb purchase progress: draft, pending approval, approved pending execution, executing, completed, rejected, cancelled and compensating
separate approval and execution evidence in user and operator views
operator timeline link by operation_id and workflow_instance_id
permission-aware route projection without using UI hiding as authorization
future console governance view only through existing management/audit APIs

security_requirements: tenant_id is server-derived and client-supplied tenant fields cannot switch context
department identity uses tenant_id + department_id; names are display-only
all mutating commands run backend authorization and expected-version checks
Agent permissions are down-scoped intersections and short-lived
Agent cannot self-approve, self-elevate or modify its own grant
high-risk delete, ACL, cross-tenant and recovery actions require explicit policy/approval
audit payloads exclude credentials, tokens and raw sensitive content
external plugins use declared capabilities, process isolation and production mTLS/signatures
compatibility_requirements: existing sverpweb purchase API remains readable during expand/contract migration
workflow definition and event schemas are versioned and immutable per running instance
old consumers can ignore new optional fields safely
audit-governance v1 ingest remains compatible or receives a backwards-compatible event schema
minimal does not require full external infrastructure
production is a real policy/profile and not only a full alias
each repository remains independently buildable and passes its own hard gates
observability_requirements: operation_id, workflow_instance_id, execution_run_id and trace_id propagate across sync and async boundaries
audit records allow/deny, approval, execution, revocation and recovery outcomes
metrics cover workflow age, SLA, retries, failures, queue depth, audit lag and Agent revocation
high-cardinality identifiers are kept out of unbounded metrics labels
audit and telemetry remain separate evidence classes
test_plan: unit tests for workflow transitions, SoD, approval policy, idempotency, version conflict and compensation
contract tests for Snaplink authorization, aero-id organization, audit ingest, asset reference and plugin manifest
integration test for sverpweb transaction plus durable outbox plus audit-governance ledger
integration test for department membership changes and immediate permission re-evaluation
Agent tests for grant scope, expiration, cancellation, fencing and self-approval rejection
composition E2E for purchase submit -> department -> finance -> execution -> audit timeline
negative E2E for tenant spoofing, name-based department mapping, rejection, timeout and notification failure
Profile tests proving minimal/full/production inventory and dependency differences
deployment_order: approve contracts and change manifest in the main platform repository
add sverpweb workflow bounded module and expand/contract migrations
freeze and consume aero-id stable department reference contract
switch critical sverpweb events to durable audit outbox
run existing aero-vault and aero-im adapters without changing their ownership
run single-tenant composition E2E and audit/telemetry verification
only then enable Agent execution and external typed plugins
production rollout after mTLS, WORM, KMS, HA and recovery gates pass
rollback_plan: stop new workflow instance creation while keeping existing definition versions readable
keep legacy purchase API read mapping during workflow migration
disable Agent grants and revoke active runs before plugin rollback
retain all audit events and replay only through idempotent consumers
use domain compensation commands for executed side effects
do not restore by editing audit records or blindly rewinding business rows
preserve unresolved department mappings for manual reconciliation

open_risks: sverpweb remains single-tenant and cannot be made shared-instance safe by only adding tenant_id to workflow tables
current sverpweb FileShareStore and aero-vault ACL synchronization can create duplicate permission authority
current best-effort audit callers need critical-path durable outbox enforcement
aero-id organization API/event availability and stable ID contract need final approval
Agent revocation latency must be bounded for already-issued capabilities
audit actor provenance may require a backward-compatible audit-governance schema extension
generic Workflow extraction should not happen before the sverpweb vertical slice demonstrates stable boundaries
plugin signatures, provenance, SBOM and production key management are not yet a single cross-repository release gate
